notes.title: Steam Festival Patch!
notes.content:
Oh boy, do we have a lot of cool changes since the last time we did the Steam Festival!

[h3]Gameplay[/h3]
[list]
[*] 2 new ball modifiers for custom games! Homing ball, and Super-ball! (These are still experimental, and we're still working on performance / client-side prediction on the homing ball)
[*] custom games will cycle maps now, keeping the same players indefinitely
[*] those annoying water pools in the canyon level have been replaced with sticky tar-pits, causing a 50% movement speed reduction!
[/list]

[h3]Visuals[/h3]
[list]
[*] new lighting in most of the levels (Shoutout to our friend Scotty for the crash course!)
[*] swapped the in-game cursor for mouse / keyboard users (looks more like a crosshair now)
[*] new hats and skins!
[/list]

These aren't the only things that have changed since the last time you played, but they're the big things. 
[url=http://discord.gg/suckerbird]Come talk to us on Discord if you have any questions![/url]

See you out there!

notes.title: Playtesting is live!
notes.content:
[h2]How To Sign Up:[/h2]
[h3][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1035570/Whiffle_Blasters/]On our Steam page[/url], click the button to [b]Request Access[/b] to the Playtest![/h3]
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1035570/Whiffle_Blasters/][img]https://i.imgur.com/jwCLmO5.png[/img][/url]
[h3]and while you're at it, make sure you've got it on your wishlist![/h3]


[h2]Feedback![/h2]
[h3]We need your help in this open testing period to make sure things run smoothly for our Early Access release! Please make sure to provide feedback via the in-game feedback tool! [/h3]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/J3oWE5P.png[/img]


[h2]Here are some things you can look forward to during this Playtest:[/h2]
[h3]- New unlockable items!
- A couple of experimental ball modifiers (for custom games)
- Updates to existing levels[/h3]


[h2]Making an indie game is HARD![/h2]
[h3]Here are a few easy and FREE ways you can support our project:

- Get your friends to play in the Open Beta with you!
- Get people to Wishlist Whiffle Blasters on Steam!
- Share the game on social media!
[url=discord.gg/suckerbird]- Join our Discord to stay in the loop![/url]

[url=Discord.gg/suckerbird][img]https://i.imgur.com/QewOMbl.gif[/img][/url][/h3]

notes.title: Early Access Announcement!
notes.content:
[h3]Whiffle Blasters is coming to Early Access February 12th![/h3]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/zforkHx.gif[/img]
[h3]We know it's been a long time coming, and we appreciate your patience! In order to ensure the best possible release, we will be doing a few more playtests before our official release! [/h3]

[h2]Playtesting / Beta[/h2]
[h3]Make sure you've requested access to our playtest to play for free before release![/h3]
[h3]On our [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1035570/Whiffle_Blasters/]Steam page[/url], click the button to [b]Request Access[/b] to the Playtest![/h3]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/jwCLmO5.png[/img]

[h3]We're so excited to bring this game to the public! And thank you so much for being a part of our cozy community during development![/h3]

notes.title: Whiffle Blasters Patch! [0.5.62]
notes.content:
Hey all! This event has been wonderful so far, and I just wanted to push out a minor quality-of-life update for our wonderful streamers who have been hosting community events!

[h2]Bugfixes[/h2]
[list]
[*]Reduced the post-game time to 8 seconds (down from 12)
[*]Custom Games now wait 30 seconds before automatically starting (will still start automatically if the game is filled)
[/list]

Thanks and hope you're having an awesome Steam Game Festival! Please report any additional bugs you may find through the in-game feedback, or check out our discord below!

notes.title: Whiffle Blasters will be Free to Play during the Steam Games Festival!
notes.content:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/ok1xNSP.png[/img]

[h3]Hey friends! We just wanted to let you know that our game Whiffle Blasters will be free to play all week during the Festival! We also have plenty of streamers lined up in case you're more of a spectator! 

We've been working so hard on this game for the past 2 years, and we can't wait for you to try it out! Please share this with your friends and coworkers! We guarantee it'll be a good time![/h3]

[u][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1035570/Whiffle_Blasters/][h2]Is our game on your wishlist? 'Cause it should be! [/h2][/url][/u]
[h3]We're planning to release the game this year, and throwing it on your wishlist will be the best way on Steam to get notified when it releases![/h3]

[u][url=discord.gg/suckerbird][h2] You can also Join our Discord to stay in the loop![/h2][/url][/u]
